API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APICloud & Branch Connector GroupsUpdate Ec Route
Update Ec Route
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecgroup/:ecgroupId/vm/:vmId/route/:ecRouteId

Updates the Cloud or Branch Connector route details within a specific VM based on the provided route ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ecgroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector group ID.

vmId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the VM.

ecRouteId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector route ID.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
ecVmId
int32

The VM ID of the Cloud or Branch Connector group.

id
int32

The route ID.

meta
object
modTime
int64

The time when the route details were last modified.

modUid
int32

ID of the user who created or last modified the route details.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
ecVmId
int32

The VM ID of the Cloud or Branch Connector group.

id
int32

The route ID.

meta
object
modTime
int64

The time when the route details were last modified.

modUid
int32

ID of the user who created or last modified the route details.
